seoTitle: Due Date by Working Days Calculator with Your Own Holidays
metaDescription: Add or subtract working days from a start date, skipping weekends and the holidays you list. Free.
intro: Moves forward or back a number of working days, skipping weekend days and the holiday dates you paste.
why:
Delivery and legal deadlines count working days. Choose your weekend, add your holidays and get the date.

The start day is not counted. Holidays are only those you list, since the tool does not fetch any calendar.
howTo: Enter a start date and number of working days.
